## Summary

`CordbProcess::GetVersion` currently reports the product version compiled into DBI, assuming that DBI and the target runtime are version-matched. That assumption does not hold for universal DBI.

Add `IDacDbiInterface::GetRuntimeVersion` and route `CordbProcess::GetVersion` through it. The cDAC implementation reads the target's existing `RuntimeInfo.GetRuntimeProductVersion()` contract, removes prerelease/build labels, and returns the product version as `major.minor.patch.0`. The native DAC retains its version-matched constants.

The DBI call uses the standard public API locking and lifetime checks and returns `CORDBG_E_NOTREADY` if the DAC has not initialized. Regression coverage exercises target versions different from the reader's build, prerelease/build labels, all mock target architectures, invalid versions, null output pointers, and contract failures.

cc @rcj1

## Validation

Passed: Checked Windows x64 builds of `mscordbi`, `mscordbi_universal`, and `mscordaccore`:

```powershell
& $env:ComSpec /c 'call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Enterprise\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul && cmake --build artifacts\obj\coreclr\windows.x64.Checked --target mscordbi mscordbi_universal mscordaccore --parallel 8'
```

Passed: 464 focused cDAC tests, with zero failures or skips:

```powershell
& .\.dotnet\dotnet.exe test src\native\managed\cdac\tests\UnitTests\Microsoft.Diagnostics.DataContractReader.Tests.csproj -c Debug -p:RuntimeConfiguration=Debug -p:LibrariesConfiguration=Release --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~DacDbiImplTests|FullyQualifiedName~RuntimeInfoTests'
```

Live debugger integration and NativeAOT publishing of cDAC were not run.
